summary: OpenAI announced a 10-day hackathon with Google Chrome, Cloudflare, Shopify, Vercel, Render and Netlify to build experiences using WebMCP, an experimental open standard letting web apps expose tools for agents to use directly on a page.

practices.reason: WebMCP describes a pattern for exposing page-level tools to agents but the post gives no implementation detail or measured gain, only a hackathon call.
practices.quote: WebMCP is an experimental open standard that lets web apps expose tools that agents can use directly on the page, helping them complete tasks faster and more reliably.
